Resolves #20375

Extends `buildScripts/util/check-consumer-runtime-build.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/checkConsumerRuntimeBuild.spec.mjs` to enforce the production-artifact isolation contract from Epic #20370 (`D#18775` OQ2 / OQ4 and `STEP_BACK` point 6):
- Verifies across every compiled Data, Canvas, App, and Main bundle (`development` and `production`) that the dedicated-worker Neural Link harness adapter (`test/playwright/dedicatedWorkerNeuralLink.mjs`), the Playwright fixture entry (`test/playwright/fixtures.mjs`), any `test/playwright/*` module, and any misplaced `src/main/addon/*NeuralLink*.mjs` addon remain absent (`TEST_HARNESS_ABSENCE_EXPECTATIONS`).
- Probes the installed package's `DefaultConfig.mjs` and `src/worker/App.mjs` via `probeAppWorkerDispatchSurface()` / `collectAppWorkerDispatchSurfaceFailures()` to verify that `allowAiClientInTests` and `useAiClient` default to `false`, `resolveAiClientBoot` returns `null` for flag-off `development` and `dist/production` boots, and `Neo.worker.App.config.remote` exposes the exact 9 pre-change `main` remote methods (`EXPECTED_APP_WORKER_REMOTE`) with no additional targets or methods.
- Adds `test/playwright/dedicatedWorkerNeuralLink.mjs` and `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs` to `.github/workflows/consumer-runtime-build.yml` `paths` so future harness changes trigger the consumer runtime build guard in CI.

Evidence: L2 (Consumer Runtime Build CI workflow pack/install/compile + live Node subprocess dispatch-surface probe in `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/checkConsumerRuntimeBuild.spec.mjs`) → L2 required (build-artifact & runtime dispatch-surface verification).
